fit: visual hallucinations after levodopa in juvenile monogenic parkinsonism
assessment: The original case records visual hallucinations with dopaminergic side effects during treatment. Neither episode frequency nor dried fig exposure is recorded. Dried blood spot and figure labels account for the lexical overlap.

fit: isolated raspberry ketone and behavioral outcomes in stressed mice
assessment: Forced swim, tail suspension, locomotion and sucrose preference measured depression-related and activity proxies after oral isolated ketone. No whole frozen Rubus fruit or separate anxiety endpoint. This is distinct from the retracted 2022 work.

fit: acute Parkinson apathy VAS across stimulation states
assessment: The omnibus apathy p=.009 in Table 2 exceeds the stated corrected .005 threshold. Dorsal versus stimulation off has a nominal +7.1 difference (SD 20.8, p=.006, higher is less apathetic). The comparison concerns DBS and has no dried date exposure.

fit: baseline apathy item as a predictor of impulse-control behaviors
assessment: The Oxford early Parkinson cohort treated MDS-UPDRS apathy score at least 1 as a predictor of impulse-control behaviors (adjusted OR 2.71, 95% CI 1.34 to 5.52). This is symptom context without an apathy change estimate or dried dates.

fit: green versus gold kiwi meal and porcine brain bioamines
assessment: The author abstract and matching dissertation experiment describe 48 pigs, post-meal GABA and other bioamine trajectories by cultivar. Tissue analysis is a biochemical endpoint, not a human attention performance measure. The two cultivar meals also differ in fiber and other nutrients.
